title: ebenus compacta
intro: Ebenus compacta, commonly known as Sweet Thorn, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. It is known to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Ebenus compacta include its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to remove excess fluid from the body, and its potential to lower blood pressure due to its vasodilatory effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
